plan.policy: Owner-approved bounded channel attribution. Five fixed reconstructions per saved mode and development point. Reconstructed native XYB DC channels only; all saved AC and filter decisions fixed. No encoder entry, new encoded configurations, fitting, peer decisions or holdout reads.
plan.interpretation: Within-mode restoration benefits and paired-mode differences are diagnostic counterfactuals. They have no attainable bitrate or promotion claim. Channels interact through filters and color conversion; single-channel benefits need not add to the all-channel benefit. Native B restoration differs from coded B-minus-Y allocation.
plan.analysis: Report full cohort, fixed distances, and the previously recorded 17 Butteraugli-max harms above 1%. Compare each restoration within each mode and between modes. Report actual-render scorer parity before attributing differences; do not select a new configuration.

summary.interpretation: SSIM changes are score points. Within-mode BA changes divide by that mode actual score. Paired BA differences at every variant divide by the original actual aligned score, so removal terms share a denominator. Single-channel contributions are actual paired difference minus restored paired difference, not additive causal shares. The interaction residual is actual minus the three single-channel contributions. No attainable bitrate or encoder policy is inferred.
summary.limits: A fixed descriptive development audit, with no fitted predictor or validation split. The pre-existing 17 harm cases are a reported subgroup; all 80 pairs are retained. No holdout images or identities are read. Source DC cannot be free in a real stream.

verification.limits: Saved image and stream integrity and exact scorer parsing. No re-encoding or extra metric runs.

archive.prerequisite: DC-DISPLAY-AUDIT.patch and its preparer, plus saved development streams and display-audit receipts
archive.policy: Four first-party offline diagnostic files. Reuses the previous display audit and its unchanged attributed Gaborish/dither helpers. No new source port or active encoder changes.

previousTrial.unresolved: Two previously reported admitted holdout SSIM guards fail, worst +11.202599% versus +8.05%; zero full-band BA3 admissions. No holdout data read in this audit.

disposition.authorization: One bounded channel-attribution audit complete. No further experiment, port or promotion is authorized by these diagnostics.
